title: Replace the session conversation minimap with clickable checkpoint dots on the native scrollbar
outcome: Each session shows the native scrollbar with one clickable dot per checkpoint (nearby dots grouped with a count and a per-checkpoint chooser); the overview minimap, its /overview endpoint and overview-only metadata are removed when nothing else uses them.
acceptance: Behavioural UI tests show a session with checkpoint markers renders the native scrollbar and one clickable dot per checkpoint at its message position (all checkpoint-kind markers), that clicking a dot navigates to that checkpoint including one whose message is not yet loaded in the visible history, and that dots too close to separate are grouped with a count and a chooser that navigates to each grouped checkpoint.

Ordinary scrollbar navigation is kept, as Greg specified: behavioural tests show that dragging the thumb, clicking the track, the scroll wheel and keyboard scrolling move through the conversation as today, with today's accessibility, and that scrolling toward a part of a long history that is not yet loaded still reaches it (the existing history loading still triggers), so no navigation reach is lost by removing the rail.

The colored content-segment visualisation (the overview minimap rail, its controller and its overview fetch) is removed, and no session pane makes an overview request; a behavioural test shows a session with many messages and no checkpoints renders no segment rail and issues no overview fetch.

The server's overview endpoint and overview-only persisted metadata are removed only after a search shows no remaining consumer; removing persisted columns or tables follows the existing persistence floor and migration rules with tests, or, if removal would need a floor change, the item records that and leaves the storage in place unread rather than changing the floor without coordinator allocation.
cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit is clean, the affected vitest suites pass, cargo check is clean, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
